_note: Timers in seconds. Build costs are PLACEHOLDERS. build_time = seconds of construction after placing (starting buildings are already built). workers = jobs it offers once built (PLACEHOLDER). When there are fewer people than jobs, every building with workers runs slower in proportion (plan.md 5.6). Batches/timers scaled for a ~1-2h offline window; per-minute rates match plan.md 5.4.
